source: OpenDota: professional item-purchase counts by game phase

patch.scope: Latest dotaconstants entry, not a filter applied to item popularity

caveats: The endpoint does not expose a sample window, patch filter, carry role, or unique match count.
Purchase popularity is descriptive; it does not establish an optimal build.

juggernaut_blade_fury.label: Blade Fury
juggernaut_blade_fury.description: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

juggernaut_healing_ward.label: Healing Ward
juggernaut_healing_ward.description: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.

juggernaut_blade_dance.label: Blade Dance
juggernaut_blade_dance.description: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

juggernaut_swift_slash.label: Swiftslash
juggernaut_swift_slash.description: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.

juggernaut_bladeform.label: Bladeform
juggernaut_bladeform.description: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.

juggernaut_omni_slash.label: Omnislash
juggernaut_omni_slash.description:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
